messages.author: b419b3f42893b2f1
messages.subject: Server performance
parts:
Hi,

Sorry if this has been answered before, but I couldn't find info anywhere. I have a pretty computationally intensive app - can I expect to see improved performance in a single instance if I decide to upgrade from free to the basic or standard package? 

Thanks!
Anders

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Server performance
parts:
Hi Anders,
There are no performance improvements to be had today by upgrading to the paid tier.   We actually have such items on our backlog but haven't done anything with it yet since we haven't seen any real demand for it. It would be great to understand a bit more of what you are trying to do so that we can make sure your use cases can be supported well.  

-Tareef

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Server performance
parts:
Thank you for your reply. If there is anything specific you want to know, let me where and how I should describe it. Generally speaking, it concerns data matrices of about 200 by 200 values and up, with dynamic feature selection and model calibration and testing using different cross validation approaches. 

Looking again, I find that my app isn't more than perhaps 20% slower when deployed than when run locally. But it would be great if it was 20% faster instead :).

Thanks again,
Anders
